ChromaDB is an open-source vector database designed to store embeddings and enable efficient similarity search for EU commercial RAG deployments.
LangChain provides components for loading data generating text embeddings and chaining vector retrievers with LLMs globally.
Legacy ChromaDB persistence rules apply to archival databases built prior to 2024.
